findings.location: Definition, material-motion paragraph: the domain declaration for chi in I x U and the condition chi(0,a)=a.
findings.evidence: The definition permits any open time interval I but evaluates chi at t=0 without requiring 0 in I. For an allowed interval excluding zero, chi(0,a) is outside the declared domain. This draft is in current-run batch 3 and reaches the assigned consumer through post-fd-continuum-balances. It does not affect the local PDE scaling algebra, but leaves that transitive continuum-model definition ill-formed for those intervals. Require 0 in I or normalize at a specified t_* in I.
